title: Earth Science Tech, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Earth Science Tech, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors approved an amendment to Article I, Section 4 of the Company's Bylaws to permit electronic delivery of shareholder meeting notices. The company is a micro-cap OTC Bulletin Board issuer (ticker ETST) based in Miami, Florida.
